description_for_human: Paste any code snippet and receive an instant, detailed AI-powered code review covering bugs, performance, security, style, and best practices.
description_for_model: AI Code Reviewer analyses code submitted by developers and returns a structured Markdown review. The review covers bug detection, performance bottlenecks, security vulnerabilities, code style, DRY/SOLID principles, refactoring suggestions, and documentation advice. It acts as a senior engineer with 7+ years of experience. To use it, POST the code string to https://code-reviewer-g.vercel.app/ai/get-review with JSON body {"code": "<code>"} and receive a Markdown review string in the response body.
